title: Tech Note: Maintaining User Modifiable Choice Lists

historical_commentary.text: This note presents a generic, copy-paste-able code scheme for preserving end-user customizations to 'User Modifiable' choice lists across structure updates, since choice lists were stored in the structure and would otherwise be overwritten by default lists on every new build; the specific classic choice-list mechanism and structure/data separation described are tied to 4D's pre-Project-Mode binary structure model, though the underlying problem (preserving user customizations across app updates) remains a generally relevant software design concern.
related_updates: 4D's classic choice list mechanism (structure-stored, 'User Modifiable' flag) has been carried forward but modern 4D development also uses collections/ORDA-driven dynamic choice lists loaded from data rather than structure-embedded lists

Since Project Mode (v17, 2018), 4D structure elements including forms and lists live as text/JSON files, changing how structure vs. data separation and update deployment are handled compared to this note's binary-structure-era approach
